new_page.title: Burnaby Penthouses for Sale | Prices and Buildings
new_page.description: Search Burnaby penthouses for sale. 80 sold over the past twelve months at a median of $705,000, with prices by neighbourhood and building.

faq.q: How much does a penthouse cost in Burnaby?
faq.a: The 80 penthouses that sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026 had a median of $705,000, with the middle half between $575,000 and $1,056,250. All Burnaby condos had a median of $647,500.

faq.q: How does a Burnaby penthouse compare in price with other condos?
faq.a: A penthouse cost 9% more at the median, or $794 a square foot against $824 for all condos. Compare the floor area, the strata fee and the roof or terrace before you decide.

faq.q: How fast do Burnaby penthouses sell?
faq.a: 20 days at a median, closing at 96.6% of list, with 5% over the list price.

faq.q: What counts as a penthouse in Burnaby?
faq.a: 80 of the 1,656 Burnaby condo sales carried Penthouse in the style field, most of them in Metrotown (22 sales). The listing agent enters that, so some top-floor homes are unmarked and a marked one is not always on the very top floor.

faq.q: Do Burnaby penthouses have higher strata fees?
faq.a: The median strata fee was $508 a month for penthouses and $456 for all condos.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Sold figures come from Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. The live search is not connected yet.

This search lists penthouses for sale in Burnaby North, Burnaby South and Burnaby East: top-floor condos that the listing marks as a penthouse. It covers Metrotown, Brentwood, Lougheed and the Edmonds and Royal Oak corridors. Other condos, townhomes and houses are separate searches.

80 Burnaby penthouses sold from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, out of 1,656 condo sales in the same area and months. The median penthouse sold for $705,000, 9% more than the $647,500 median for all condos, in 20 days at a median.

26% of Burnaby penthouses sold for $1,000,000 or more, compared with 6% of all condos in the same months.
About buying a top-floor home in Burnaby
Burnaby’s 2026 municipal residential rate is $1.72223 per $1,000 of assessed value, with a Metro Vancouver rate of $0.05440 on top, and the city is inside the Speculation and Vacancy Tax area.
The Burnaby 2050 Official Community Plan was adopted on December 9, 2025, and the new Zoning Bylaw 2026 took effect July 1, 2026.
Before you offer on a Burnaby penthouse

items.t: Find out the roof’s age from the strata minutes. A depreciation report shows when a replacement is expected and how it will be paid for.
Look for building-envelope work in the minutes, and ask whether any water-damage claim has been filed against the strata’s policy.
Ask how the terrace is classed under the strata plan. An owned lot and limited common property carry different repair duties.
Ask about air conditioning rules. Many top floors run warm in summer, and strata bylaws may limit where a unit can go.

Compare the building’s fee with the $508 a month median for Burnaby penthouses and $456 for all condos. A fee well above that deserves a look at what it covers. The median Burnaby penthouse sold was built in 2013.
